title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise StoreOnce VSA deletePackages Directory Traversal Arbitrary File Deletion Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to delete arbitrary files on affected installations of Hewlett Packard Enterprise StoreOnce VSA. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the deletePackages method. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to delete files in the context of root.
